messages.content: Answer helpfully and concisely. Retain the conversation's details.
Use run_command once with command "sleep 15; printf 'HINT-JOB-DONE\n'" and ai_callback_delay 20. After it returns, follow any hint I send and give a concise final answer. Do not call other tools.
HINT-ACCEPTED-FIVE. The command output was "HINT-JOB-DONE" after a 15-second sleep, indicating successful completion.
Use run_command exactly once with command "sleep 180; printf 'LATE-JOB\n'" and ai_callback_delay 60. Do not use tool_limits or other tools; after that report give a short answer.
job 2 status: running; output: cr/io/2; total bytes: 0; use wait_for_job, send_input, or kill_job
Reply with exactly QUEUED-FIVE; do not call tools.
Inspect still-owned job 2 with wait_for_job handle 2 and ai_callback_delay 0. Then explicitly stop that job using kill_job handle 2. Briefly report its observed state before and after the kill.
job 2 status: running; output: cr/io/2; total bytes: 0; use wait_for_job, send_input, or kill_job
job 2 status: killed; output: cr/io/2; total bytes: 0
Before the kill, job 2 was still running with no output produced. After the kill, job 2 was terminated (status: killed) with no output produced.

Start one managed job with run_command command "sleep 180; printf 'CLEANUP-LATE\n'" and ai_callback_delay 0. Give me its handle, then finish your answer. Do not wait or kill it; I will close the session.
job 3 status: running; output: cr/io/3; total bytes: 0; use wait_for_job, send_input, or kill_job
